item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00359","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C10","C24","C22"],"selected_candidate_label":"C10","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C10 is expressly identified in the child and supplies its central policy language nearly verbatim. The child quotes C10's declarations that racial discrimination contradicts constitutional principles and that the Executive Branch should encourage equal opportunity through positive measures, then adapts that policy into an immediate agency-wide prohibition concerning employee recreational organizations and a compliance-report requirement. C24 and C22 concern federal nondiscrimination and agency-head responsibility, but their language and machinery are less directly reflected in the child.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"Executive Order Number 10925, promulgated March 6, 1961, reaffirms that \"discrimination because of race, creed, color or national origin is contrary to the Constitutional principles and policies of the United States\"","parent_excerpt":"WHEREAS discrimination because of race, creed, color, or national origin is contrary to the Constitutional principles and policies of the United States","explanation":"The child expressly attributes and reproduces C10's distinctive constitutional-policy declaration."},{"child_excerpt":"\"it is the policy of the Executive Branch of the Government to encourage by positive measures equal opportunity for all qualified persons within the Government.\"","parent_excerpt":"WHEREAS it is the policy of the executive branch of the Government to encourage by positive measures equal opportunity for all qualified persons within the Government","explanation":"This is nearly verbatim language from C10 and supplies the stated basis for the child's operative command."},{"child_excerpt":"I want immediate and specific action taken to assure that no use is made of the name, sponsorship, facilities, or activity of any Executive Department or Agency by or for any employee recreational organization practicing discrimination based on race, creed, color, or national origin.","parent_excerpt":"All executive departments and agencies are directed to initiate forthwith studies of current government employment practices within their responsibility... [including] positive measures for the elimination of any discrimination","explanation":"The child adapts C10's executive-branch-wide affirmative-action and immediate-compliance framework to discriminatory employee recreational associations."},{"child_excerpt":"Current practices in each Department are to be brought into immediate compliance with this policy, and a report by the head of each Executive Agency filed to that effect before May 1, 1961.","parent_excerpt":"Reports and recommendations shall be submitted to the Executive Vice Chairman of the Committee no later than sixty days from the effective date of this order","explanation":"Both use prompt department-level review and a deadline-bound reporting mechanism to enforce the nondiscrimination policy, though the child's mechanism is simplified and directed to a narrower target."}]}
